10k.note: Veracyte is a global diagnostics company. Tests address prostate cancer (Decipher Prostate), thyroid cancer (Afirma), bladder cancer (Decipher Bladder, formerly Decipher Bladder GRS), breast cancer (Prosigna), idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (Envisia) and lymphoma (Lymphmark). No proprietary drug pipeline disclosed.

website.error: no public drug pipeline page found (Veracyte is a diagnostics company without a therapeutic pipeline page)

ctgov.note: All 3 P1-3 trials have Veracyte as a collaborator only — investigator-initiated or pharma-sponsored studies (UCSD prostate radiotherapy; Gustave Roussy/BeiGene tislelizumab MRD; Cancer Research Antwerp/Bayer darolutamide). Veracyte's role is supplying diagnostic tests, not a proprietary therapeutic asset.

commercial_product.summary: Veracyte is a genomic diagnostics company that develops and commercializes molecular tests for cancer and other diseases.
key_franchises: Decipher Prostate (genomic classifier, NCCN-included for risk stratification)
Percepta Nasal Swab and Percepta Genomic Sequencing Classifier (lung cancer risk)
